assessment: The manuscript by Godbole et al. proposes a novel mechanism by which different S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) synthase enzymes exhibit specificity towards target sequences, establishing a layer of control over H3K4 trimethylation (H3K4me3). The authors demonstrate that the loss of two SAMs (sams-1 and sams-4) differentially impacts stress response phenotypes, histone methylation, and gene expression profiles. This work suggests a role of enzyme provisioning in selecting specific targets for epigenetic modification.
